effect: Weapon. +1 Attack die. Small, folding, and always in his pocket.

name: Flashlight
effect: Counts as a light source for Charlie checks. Batteries included — for now.

name: Headphones
effect: Comfort. Single-use: discard at Night for +2 Sanity — drown the noises out.

name: First Aid Kit
effect: Single-use. Restore 4 Health to any player at your location.
art_notes: white first aid box with a red cross and an angel sticker

name: Comfort Blanket
effect: Comfort. While held: +1 Sanity whenever you sleep indoors. Tradeable — someone always needs it more.
art_notes: soft knitted blanket folded neatly

name: Hopeful Tea
effect: Single-use. One player at your tile: +2 Sanity and +1 Hunger. Best shared warm.
art_notes: steaming thermos of tea painted with flowers

name: Spare Phone Battery
effect: Single-use. Refill a dead Flashlight, or count as 1 Battery toward a craft.
art_notes: small phone battery with a charm attached

name: Friendship Bracelet
effect: Keepsake. Single-use: +1 Sanity to you and one ally at your tile — remember who you're surviving for.
art_notes: woven friendship bracelet with beads

name: Basketball
effect: Improvised weapon. +1 Attack die. The pump fake works on monsters too.
art_notes: well-worn basketball with hand-drawn flames

name: Sports Drink
effect: Single-use. +2 Hunger. Electrolytes for the end of the world.
art_notes: neon sports drink bottle

name: Athletic Tape
effect: Single-use. Restore 2 Health — or mend a broken Weapon back to working order.
art_notes: roll of white athletic tape

name: Whistle
effect: Single-use. When a Threat appears at your tile: one ally at an adjacent tile may immediately move to you for free.
art_notes: metal coach whistle on a lanyard

name: Crockpot
effect: Portable Crockpot. Cooking with it counts as being at a Crockpot location — home is where the pot is.
art_notes: battered slow cooker with floral decals

name: Soup Recipe
effect: Reference. Grandma's soup, in her handwriting. The Recipe rack has the team's full cookbook — keep this one safe.
art_notes: handwritten recipe card, stained and loved

name: Cooking Knife
effect: Weapon. +1 Attack die. Keeps a better edge than any bat.
art_notes: professional chef's knife on a wooden board

name: Pantry Key
effect: Key. Single-use: one player Gathering at Ellie & Luca's House picks a specific resource instead of drawing random.
art_notes: ornate brass pantry key

name: Apron
effect: Comfort. While worn: +1 Sanity whenever you cook a shared meal — they said thank you.
art_notes: flour-dusted apron with ruffles

name: Notebook
effect: Keepsake. Once per day at Night, if an ally is at your tile: read the day back aloud — +1 Sanity to you.

name: Loud Whistle
effect: Single-use. At Night: everyone at your tile counts as together — nobody there is alone tonight.
art_notes: large brass whistle

name: Pep Talk
effect: Single-use. One ally at your tile: +2 Sanity. You always know what to say.
art_notes: index card with bold underlined words

name: Reading Lamp
effect: Comfort. Too dim to scare Charlie (NOT a light source) — but read by it at Night for +1 Sanity.

effect: Tool. Single-use: complete a Craft while short exactly one resource — the toolbox had a spare part.
